fullAccessDescription: Automatically approve every tool operation in the backend without approval prompts
riskyOperationsDescription: Automatically approve routine sandboxed work; ask before authority expansion, deletion, installation, or external operations
approvalRequiredDescription: Ask before every tool operation that requires authorization

sessionGrants.title: Allowed this session
sessionGrants.loadFailed: Session grants could not be loaded. The previous list is retained.
sessionGrants.uncertain: Revocation was not confirmed. Retry sends only the original observed grant IDs.
sessionGrants.scopeChanged: This account or conversation identity is no longer available. Reopen the current conversation.
sessionGrants.invalid: The revocation request was rejected. No replacement request was sent.
sessionGrants.changed: Some grants were renewed after this list was shown and were not revoked. Review the updated list.
sessionGrants.alreadyAbsent: Some observed grants are already absent; this does not prove this request removed them.
sessionGrants.incomplete: Some session grants could not be listed. Clear all is unavailable; visible categories can still be revoked.
sessionGrants.legacy: {{count}} legacy unbound records are not active session grants.
sessionGrants.stale: {{count}} records belong to an older session identity and are not active grants.
sessionGrants.boundary: Revocation affects future authorization checks. Already-admitted work continues; project and global policies are unchanged.
